purpose: Remove the response-treatment and prompt-style confounds that prevent RS and MS effects from being causally identified, while separating development promotion from formal head pass and final Paper 1 success.

RS_current_treatment.observed: Baseline won 31/33 clean RS-only same-stack pairs across EvoEmo and ESConv; only 2/28 independent groups showed material benefit.
RS_current_treatment.identified_failure: The current compiler turns RS into the sole primary act, and the dominant Restatement card forbids the acknowledgement, question, advice, or forward move that complete R0 replies retain.
RS_current_treatment.bounded_conclusion: The current replacement treatment fails. This does not identify the effect of an additive, state-matched RS strategy delta.

MS_current_treatment.observed: On 19 selected MS-ON states from 11 owners, routed won 12, baseline won 4, and 3 tied; owner directions were 7 positive, 2 negative, and 2 tied (one-sided exact p=0.0898). Baseline had three nonzero-risk pairs and routed had zero.
MS_current_treatment.identified_failure: Thirteen of 19 responses safely did not use the specific memory, yet eight of the twelve quality wins occurred in that non-use slice. Generic response-program style therefore confounds memory-attributable Function.
MS_current_treatment.bounded_conclusion: This is positive development evidence that promotes MS treatment repair and confirmation. It is neither a formal MS pass nor a failure requiring p<0.05 at this stage.

invariant_R0_foundation: safety, refusal, stop, and burden boundaries
a complete useful reply when all optional resources are absent
at most one appropriate forward question, choice, next step, or closure

RS_delta.definition: R0 plus one bounded strategy move; RS never replaces the R0 foundation.
RS_delta.restatement_rule: Restatement is a local contribution and may not be the entire response or suppress useful forward motion.
RS_delta.selector_estimand: Incremental benefit of R0+RS versus the identical R0 foundation, not mere strategy applicability or opportunity.

MS_delta.USE: A specific, strictly past, user-owned, relevant, non-conflicting fact contributes information not recoverable from current context alone.
MS_delta.ASK: Continuity is uncertain and a tentative check grounded in the past fact is useful.
MS_delta.IGNORE: The fact is redundant, stale, vague, conflicting, wrong-owner, present in current context, or not useful now.
MS_delta.function_boundary: A better generic question, warmth, or response length with no past-information contribution counts as R0 quality, never MS Function.

joint_order: one coherent forward move or closure
same_stack_requirements: same generator, endpoint, base prompt, current context, seed policy, output cap, and R0 foundation
only the requested component delta and its exact evidence may differ
matched response-length envelope; incomplete short replies cannot create a cost win
blind pair order and owner-clustered inference

development_promotion.role: Decide whether a repaired head merits one frozen confirmatory run; this is not a paper claim.
development_promotion.p_value_rule: No p<0.05 requirement on a small development slice.
required: both ON and OFF decisions occur on eligible development states
owner- or dialogue-level Quality direction is positive on the learned-ON slice
no critical risk event and no directional material-risk increase
source-aware Function is observed on at least two independently reviewed ON cases and is not explained by current context alone
failure cases are localized to a versioned treatment defect rather than silently tuned on confirmatory outcomes

formal_head_pass.role: Support a named RS_pass or MS_pass in the paper.
required: grouped/cross-fitted selector is nondegenerate and beats the named transparent baseline under an incremental-benefit estimand
source-aware component-attributable Function is nonzero and reproducible; generator telemetry is insufficient
overall same-stack Quality is noninferior to component-OFF at the frozen -0.05 NetWin margin
learned-ON-slice Quality has a positive point estimate and either a cluster interval lower bound above zero or an independent positive replication with no material regression
every material-risk difference upper bound is within +0.05 and no critical event is hidden by aggregation
component marginal evidence survives full-minus-component and matched-cost or matched-ON-rate controls
formal_head_pass.functional_use_rate: The prior 0.80 single-component value is an aspirational engineering reference, not an independent hard pass gate. Formal passage follows the nonzero, attributable, reproducible Function rule plus Quality/Risk evidence.

paper1_primary_pass.predicate: RS_pass AND count_pass(MP,MS,ME) >= 2 AND all three complementary external tracks pass
paper1_primary_pass.note: No small development p-value, default-OFF identity, one winning baseline comparison, or one memory head can satisfy this predicate alone.

ESConv_response.component_scope: RS/R0 only; longitudinal MS is structurally N/A and must remain OFF.
ESConv_response.pass_shape: R0+learned-RS is overall Quality/Risk noninferior to R0, positive on the learned-ON slice, better than transparent rule or matched random on a preregistered selection outcome, and cheaper than fixed-high when RS is selectively OFF.

EvoEmo_longitudinal_response.component_scope: RS and MS are tested alone and jointly with the four-arm R0/RS/MS factorial; MP/ME remain in the complete Paper 1 design.
EvoEmo_longitudinal_response.pass_shape: RS and MS each have attributable Function and noninferior overall Quality/Risk; their learned-ON slices are directionally beneficial; the joint policy adds adaptive value at matched resource amount and preserves the frozen 16-action safety/frontier requirements.

ES_MemEval_QA.component_scope: Memory retrieval/answering and abstention only; RS is structurally N/A. MS contributes to typed memory selection/transport, not supportive-response Quality.
ES_MemEval_QA.pass_shape: Learned typed memory improves answerable memory-required QA over no-memory, is accuracy/risk noninferior and at least 10% cheaper than fixed-high, and has a preregistered accuracy-cost advantage over session-RAG or full history without increasing false answers on should-abstain cases.

external_coverage_matrix.correct_complete_interpretation: The full system passes all three external experiments. RS is evidenced by ESConv plus EvoEmo; MS is evidenced by EvoEmo plus ES-MemEval. Requiring both heads to pass every dataset is a category error.

execution_order: Independently source-review the six claimed-use MS-only rows and matched safe-nonuse controls; do not spend generator calls.
Freeze and unit-test the invariant R0 plus RS/MS delta compiler under the current Llama generator.
Build outcome-blind development panels and negative controls for restatement, closure, current-context echo, stale/conflict, wrong owner, and uncertain continuity.
Run a small current-generator four-arm development factorial; estimate RS and MS main effects and interaction with owner/dialogue clustering.
If development promotion gates pass, freeze selectors, thresholds, compiler, judges, margins, baselines, and confirmatory samples before reading outcomes.
Execute ESConv RS confirmation, EvoEmo RS/MS factorial confirmation, and ES-MemEval typed-memory QA in their correct component scopes.
Only after current-generator treatment success, run the predesigned generator robustness comparison as a secondary moderator analysis.

generator_policy.reason: Changing treatment and generator simultaneously would not identify whether the root repair worked and would invite outcome-driven generator selection.

implementation.reason_live_runner_not_wired: A separate content-addressed execution manifest must first freeze exact states, prompts, endpoint, budgets, raw persistence, and measurement.
